arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/fuzz_service.py && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from compiler import compile_plan,find_deficient_cut
from compiler_proto import validate_plan
random.seed(1234)
for it in range(1500):
 n=random.randint(2,12);np=random.randint(2,min(8,n));C=sorted(random.sample(range(n),np))
 roots={v:random.choice([0,1,2,3,5]) for v in C}
 if sum(roots.values())==0:roots[C[0]]=1
 links=[]
 for u in range(n):
  for v in range(u+1,n):
   if random.random()<.4:links.append((u,v) if random.random()<.5 else (v,u))
 env={i:random.choice([0,1,1,2,3]) for i in range(len(links))};p=random.choice([1,2,3])
 cut=find_deficient_cut(n,links,C,roots,p,env)
 out,pay=compile_plan(n,links,C,roots,p,env)
 if cut is not None:assert out=='denied'
 else:
  assert out=='prepared';validate_plan(pay,n,links,C,roots,p,env)
print('OK')
